newsitem.title: USA: UroHealth restates first 3 quarters of FY97.
newsitem.headline: UroHealth restates first 3 quarters of FY97.

text.p: UroHealth Systems Inc said Tuesday it is restating the first three quarters of fiscal year 1997 lower to show the effects of a deferral of some revenue.

The company restated its net income per share for the third quarter ended Dec. 31, 1996 to $0.01 from an original $0.15. Its net loss per share for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 1996 was restated to $1.88 from an original $1.80 and its loss for the quarter ended June 30, 1996 was restated to $0.22 from an original $0.16.

The company said the deferred revenue is associated with initial stock orders to distributors for products shipped by its surgical division and new video endoscopy products shipped during fiscal 1997.

As a result, the company will defer recognition of revenue totaling $900,000, $1.3 million, $2.7 million and $11.7 million related to net shipments in the first through fourth quarters of fiscal 1997, it said.

The company will recognize revenue for restocking distributor orders on an accrual basis going forward and expects to recognize the $15.2 million for initial stock orders in subsequent periods of the current fiscal year.
In addition, the company will not recognize $1.4 million in EndoView sales shipped in 1997 but will recognize them as payment is made by the hospitals for the products, it said.
